description: Fetch a screenshot set in full: every screen's layout JSON plus per-screen translation overrides keyed by locale. By default inline image data is replaced with placeholders to keep the response readable.

include_image_data.description: When false (default), inline base64 images are replaced with short placeholders to keep the response small. Set true only when you need the raw data URLs (a layout containing placeholders is rejected on update).

name: sonar_get_screenshot_set
title: Get Screenshot Set
